responsibility: Provides GCC’s freestanding implementation of the standard <float.h> interface by mapping the compiler’s target-specific predefined floating-point macros and builtins to the ISO C/C23 constants for binary, extended, interchange, and decimal floating types. It owns the public compile-time description of floating-point formats and evaluation behavior seen by front ends and user code—such as radix, mantissa and exponent limits, decimal-digit properties, true-min/subnormal values, FLT_EVAL_METHOD, and selected NaN/Infinity macros—without performing arithmetic itself.
